description: A birth chart in the sidereal zodiac (Lahiri ayanamsa): the lagna, the nine grahas in their rashis with nakshatras and padas, whole-sign houses, navamsa (D9) signs and the Vimshottari periods with the current mahadasha and antardasha. Without the hour no lagna or houses. Calculations only.

lang.description: Language of the names in the answer: pl (default) or en

node.description: Rahu as the mean (default) or true node

place.description: A town or city, e.g. "Opole", "Kraków", "London"; the first match is used (Polish places come first)

time.description: Clock time at the place of birth, HH:MM; leave out if unknown

tz.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Warsaw (with lat and lon)

name: vedic_chart
title: Vedic (Jyotish) chart
